messages:
Rae (Fin): AuditFlow sent a pilot quote + reconciliation spec. highlights: 500k committed tokens/mo, $17 per 1M committed, $27 overage, $2,500 onboarding, monthly invoicing, prefers annual prepay for best price. link: https://vendor-quotes.internal/auditflow/20745
Tom S: can you paste the unit math and sample invoice lines? need GL mapping and whether onboarding is billed separately.
Rae (Fin): pasted sample from vendor:
```
line_item,units,unit_price,amount
committed_tokens,500000,17,8.50
overage_tokens,120000,27,3.24
onboarding_fee,1,2500,2500.00
```
Hannah (Eng): product question  does AuditFlow provide per-request exports with our hashed_request_id? we need line-by-line reconciliation to avoid surprises.
Rae (Fin): vendor replied they can include hashed_request_id, per-request token counts, and a daily CSV export. SOC2 + DPA available. they will bill from US entity, VAT excluded.
procure-bot: Reminder  create PR ticket with budget code before legal: /po create <vendor> <amount> <budget-code>.
Tom S: negotiate ask: waive onboarding for pilot, shorten to 4 months (vs their 6mo), include a 30-day review clause. also request sample export schema and a sample week of exports.
Rae (Fin): finance conditionals: green if vendor accepts PO/net-30, provides SOC2/DPA, credits onboarding, and TCV <= $80k. otherwise escalate to Legal. will need W-9 and billing entity.
LegalBot: loop legal only after PR is created and vendor accepts PO/net-30 in writing. attach DPA draft if they want redlines.
Hannah (Eng): integration ETA: with exports + keys by next Tue we can validate reconciliation in 7 business days. will automate a daily diff and flag >1.5% variance.
Tom S: i'll push for 4-month pilot with onboarding waived and a 15% pilot discount. if they push back we can accept 6mo with onboarding credited on month-1 invoice.
Rae (Fin): created procurement ticket PR-2026-411 and linked quote. I'll prepare PO for $68,000 pending written onboarding credit and SOC2 upload.
Tom S: vendor replied: willing to do 4-month pilot, will waive onboarding if we sign PO/net-30, will include hashed_request_id in CSV, SOC2 report attached. they asked us to confirm start date.
Rae (Fin): good  i'll issue PO once SOC2 and W-9 are saved to PR and vendor confirms onboarding credit in writing. aiming to start 2026-06-01.
Hannah (Eng): noted. will standby for keys and sample export to begin integration.
Tom S: thanks team, i'll update when vendor returns signed PO terms.
